title: The toast's bottom offset is a magic number that fits one host, it is dark-on-dark, and VoiceOver never hears it
claim: `MusicTransientToastChrome` pads the toast `.padding(.bottom, 110)` — the tab bar plus mini-player height — but the same modifier is mounted on the Now Playing cover, which has neither, so the toast lands over the player controls. The pill is always `Color.black.opacity(0.85)`, so in dark mode it is a black capsule on a black canvas. And no `AccessibilityNotification` is posted anywhere, so VoiceOver users never hear a toast.
description: The small black pop-up message that confirms an action is positioned for the main tab screens. When it appears on the full-screen player, it lands on top of the playback controls.
issue: On the Now Playing screen the confirmation "No similar tracks found" appeared directly over the transport row, between the play/pause button and the volume slider — covering controls the user is likely to reach for next. A VoiceOver user gets the haptic but never the message.
proposed_fix: Give `MusicTransientToastChrome` a `bottomInset: CGFloat` (default 110) and pass a small inset — ideally derived from the host's safe area — from the cover mount at RootView.swift:281. Post `AccessibilityNotification.Announcement(...)` from `AppModel.showTransientToast(_:)`. For dark mode, per the second verifier, either keep the single dark pill and add a hairline `Capsule().stroke(.white.opacity(0.15))`, or switch the fill and the two hard-coded `.white` text styles to `.primary` / `.secondary` together — changing only the fill breaks light mode.
steps: Confirm current source: MusicDesignSystem.swift:1870 `.fill(Color.black.opacity(0.85))` and :1873 `.padding(.bottom, 110)`; tree-wide grep for `AccessibilityNotification|UIAccessibility.post` returns zero hits.

Drive and record: Home → first Top Pick (The Other Side of Make‐Believe) → Play → album More menu → Play Next; wait 3 s; tap the mini player to open Now Playing; player More menu → "Add similar to queue"; wait 4 s.
Player menu contents from the accessibility dump: Play artist mix, Add similar to queue, Play more like this, Go to Album, Exclude from Listening History, Add to Playlist, Add to Library, Share.
On the cover, the toast "No similar tracks found" appears overlapping the transport row, just above the volume slider (video ~39.8-41 s).
On the album page, "Play Next" produced no visible toast within the 3 s window, so the in-tab position (where 110 pt is correct) was not captured this run.
VoiceOver cannot run in the iOS Simulator, so the missing announcement was verified in source only (zero posts tree-wide).
notes: Confirmed for the offset on the Now Playing cover (runtime) and for VoiceOver silence (source; untestable in the simulator). The dark-on-dark half was NOT observed: both surfaces in this capture sat on a grey backdrop sampled from the album artwork, where the black pill is clearly legible — reaching a pure-black canvas needs a toast raised from a screen without an artwork backdrop, which this run did not do. Filed as video because a toast is inherently temporal (it appears, then vanishes after ~1.8 s). Side effect inside the boundary: Toni and the album were queued/played on vellum-test, which creates recently-played state.
